blocks.text: Janice de Belen reiterated her support for her daughter Kaila Estrada’s relationship with Daniel Padilla, although the celebrity mom opted not to speak with finality about the couple’s future. De Belen was asked about her thoughts on Padilla as Estrada’s boyfriend during the veteran actress’ interview with Ogie Diaz, which was shared on his YouTube channel on Sunday, Oct. 11. “Okay naman siya. You know, he’s a good kid. He seems to be a good kid,” De Belen said of the actor. “Wala naman akong masabi sa kanyang masama.” “But then again, I am not in the relationship. But knowing my […]...
